title: fix(plugin-approvals): name the record by object label and id in every approval notification body
body:
Fixes #23978
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Every approval notification body that names its record now names it through `nameSubjectRecord`. The record is named by the object's label and the record id (`Deal D_123`), or by the object's API name and the id when the schema declares no label. No body carries a title, from any source. This is the form ruling B of #23556 / #23594 set, and the one `approval.requested` already sent. The rest of each sentence is unchanged.

`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, line numbers at this head. Each method names the record once and every body in that method uses that name:

- `sendBack`, `subject` at `:4752`: `approval.returned` revision-limit auto-reject (`Your Deal D_1 exceeded the revision limit …`), and the send-back with no note (`Your Deal D_1 needs rework …`).
- `reassign`, inline at `:5118`: `approval.reassigned` (`You are now an approver on Deal D_1.`).
- `remind`, `subject` at `:5164`: both `approval.reminder` bodies, the one with action links and the one to slot literals.
- `escalateRequest`, `subject` at `:6508`: `approval.escalated`, plus `approval.sla_breached` to the approvers and to the submitter.

Rendered before / after, for a `crm_deal` labelled `Deal`: `A decision on crm_deal/D_1 is overdue.` became `A decision on Deal D_1 is overdue.`

### Two sites beyond the claim's eight (a declared widening, its own commit `a42511d0ac`)

`approval.ooo_substituted` (`:3624`) and `approval.ooo_skipped` (`:3636`) in `openNodeRequest` built `${input.object}/${input.recordId}`. That renders the same slash form under a different variable spelling, so the claim's search for the `raw.object_name` spelling missed it. The battery's new slash sweep found both bodies. I fixed them in place because all four bounded in-place conditions hold:

1. They have the same defect class as this card.
2. The fix is mechanical, and the same method already calls the same helper at `:3691`.
3. No other claim holds the file (the claim records no open PR touching it).
4. They use the same test battery, so there is no new verification surface.

To drop the widening, revert `a42511d0ac`. The battery's sweep then goes red on those two bodies, which is the defect itself.

### Not changed (claim exclusions)

- The `DUPLICATE_REQUEST` refusal text at `:4903`.
- `nameSubjectRecord` and `objectLabelOf`.
- `sys-approval-request.object.ts`.
- Anything in `packages/spec`.

## Premise check (`origin/main` `5c2ac83a23`)

All eight claimed sites built `${raw.object_name}/${raw.record_id}` into a notification `body`. Each `raw` is a `sys_approval_request` row, read by `loadPendingRow` (`sendBack`, `reassign`, `remind`) or by the `runEscalations` scan (`escalateRequest`). When the request opens, its `object_name` and `record_id` are written from `input.object` and `input.recordId` (`:3556-3557`), so they are the subject record. `nameSubjectRecord` answers the label and the id, or the object name and the id when there is no label. All eight are the same family.

## Pin

`approval-notification-body.integration.test.ts` is the battery that already drives every notifying call site. It runs the real `ApprovalService` over a real `ObjectQL` on `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3, in memory), with the messaging surface recording what reaches it. This PR adds two requests to it:

- `rework`: a send-back with no note.
- `bare`: a reminder about a `crm_memo` record, an object whose schema has no label (the control).

It also adds one test. The test asserts the record's name in each body (not the sentence around it): the reminder, both SLA-breach bodies, the escalation, the hand-off, both send-back sentences and both out-of-office sentences. For the control it asserts `crm_memo D_bare`. It also sweeps every body the battery sent for the slash form.

- **Red against the unfixed source** (test-only commit `a941d0711d`): seven of the claimed sites received `crm_deal/D_…`, including the reminder (`A decision on crm_deal/D_thread is still waiting on you.`) and the SLA breach (`A decision on crm_deal/D_sla_notify is overdue.`). The four existing tests stayed green with the two added requests.
- **Green** at `a42511d0ac`: the battery passes 5/5, and the package passes 81 files / 1104 tests (`vitest run --maxWorkers=2`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck` exits 0, and `check:test-typecheck` holds the ledger unchanged (8 files / 324 errors).
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, WRAP mode): I put the SLA-breach body back to the slash form. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob changed from `c01b0f0749dd` to `46ea05a5b390`. The run went red with exactly one offender: `approval.sla_breached@sla_notify: A decision on crm_deal/D_sla_notify is overdue.` The restore was proven: the blob is `c01b0f0749dd`, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the subject relatively from `src/`, so the ablation has no `dist/` leg.
- The slot-literal reminder body (`:5201`) never reaches messaging, because `notify()` drops every slot-address audience. The battery's docblock already records this, and the compiler holds its shape.

## Gates (head `54a1f98fe6`, after merging `origin/main` `905f57bc74`)

- I ran all 67 commands from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` and recorded each exit before any pipe. 65 exited 0.
- 2 exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`), so they are NOT MEASURED. This is a declared narrowing; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs both on a full build.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package's `dist/` (37 absent), which means a whole-workspace build.
  - `pnpm check:i18n` needs the CLI's build closure plus ten packages. This diff changes no translatable source: no object or field label, nothing under `translations/`.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 67 derived, 65 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (derived from the recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN. It exits 0.
- Changeset level axis, measured offline: `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base 5c2ac83a23 --event` with this body's first two lines exits 0 (`patch` under `Clause-②: no`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Persons named by raw user id (not fixed here, reported to the seat).** The two out-of-office bodies name the people by raw user id, for example `You are covering an approval on Deal D_ooo while u_ooo is out of office.` and `… was routed to u_bob …`. This is a person-naming defect, not record naming, so it stays outside this card's family.
- **Stale docblocks.** The `objectLabelOf` and `nameSubjectRecord` docblocks still describe the helper as shared by the `approval.requested` body only. The claim excluded both from this edit, so they are left as they stand.
